name: Mariama Bâ
shortBio: Senegalese philosopher-novelist and feminist critic whose epistolary classic So Long a Letter interrogated post-independence African nationalism, polygamy, and caste prejudice from the standpoint of women's moral autonomy.
centralQuestion: Why did postcolonial African emancipation leave domestic patriarchal hierarchy and caste stratification intact, and how can female solidarity transform civic modernity?

keyWorks.title: So Long a Letter (Une si longue lettre)
keyWorks.description: Philosophical-literary critique of postcolonial Senegalese bourgeois hypocrisy, polygamous abandonment, and caste exclusion.

keyWorks.title: Scarlet Song (Un chant écarlate)
keyWorks.description: Examines intercultural alienation, patriarchal nationalism, and social norms in post-independence Senegal.
